validity.recommendation: No reclassification recommended for P3976 at this time -- distinct from the P3975 finding. The named builder/operator, AO «Газпром газораспределение Курган» (Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Kurgan), is a REGIONAL GAS-DISTRIBUTION subsidiary (not a Transgaz federal-transmission entity), building this отвод as part of the oblast's broader gasification/distribution-network programme (the same project bundled ~125-146 km of local distribution networks in Kurtamysh). One 2021 article's headline colloquially calls the pipe 'магистральный' (lay usage for 'large/backbone pipe'), which on its own is not treated as overriding the identified distribution-utility operator. Recommend leaving as distribution, but note the family-wide 'отвод-to-ГРС' pattern (which correctly flags P3975 as likely transmission) does NOT mechanically apply here, since the trangaz-operated condition is absent.

fills.researcher_notes: REFS_ADDED for the recorded value 'distribution', WITH A CAVEAT -- flagged in validity[] for a lower-confidence classification question, distinct from the P3975 finding. Unlike P3975 (operated/inspected by Transgaz Yekaterinburg, a federal transmission subsidiary), THIS отвод is built and operated by AO 'Газпром газораспределение Курган', Gazprom's regional gas-DISTRIBUTION company for Kurgan Oblast, as part of the region's gasification programme (alongside literally hundreds of km of local distribution network in the same build). The family-wide rule ('отвод terminating at a ГРС, trangaz-operated, is transmission') explicitly conditions on trangaz operation, which does not apply here. The one word 'магистральный' used colloquially in local press is not, on its own, treated as overriding the identified regional-distribution operator. Recorded distribution classification is therefore better supported for P3976 than for P3975, though not certain -- see validity[] concern_type=classification (lower severity than P3975's).
